Algorithm: the circuit implements mixed affine secp256k1 addition of a quantum

Field inversion uses a fixed 511-round binary-GCD value walk with direct

## Caveat and what is left

Approximation boundary: the named bad event is `x(P+Q)=Qx`, equivalently
`P=-2Q`. The shot results do not remove that event and do not establish an all-input
correctness theorem.

The formal results attached to the development remain theorem-scoped. They
support the fixed-round value walk, replay relationships, component width
claims, and selected arithmetic refinements, but they do not by themselves
